changelog: v0.3.8: Fixed WebLLM Qwen 2.5 getting stuck in Analyzing on Meta Quest 3: 1) Added 25s timeout and automatic fallback so analyzing never hangs; 2) Real-time progress updates for weights download and shader compilation in subtitle and VR HUD; 3) Automatic failover to Google Gemini API when key is available; 4) Graceful spoken error recovery if WebGPU memory is exhausted on Quest 3.
